subject.title: refactor(qa): retire the standalone Matrix QA runtime

question: Should maintainers accept the current `qa-matrix` retirement path, including the dependency graph deletion and secret-bearing reusable QA Live Matrix workflow boundary, after the small skill-doc indentation fix is applied?
rationale: Automation cannot approve dependency graph changes or secret-bearing workflow boundary changes, and this PR intentionally changes both while replacing a release QA execution path.

options.title: Fix Indent, Then Approve Boundary
options.body: Restore the Markdown continuation indent and have admin/security approve the dependency graph plus reusable workflow boundary for the resulting exact head.

options.title: Request A Narrower Split
options.body: Ask for the package/runtime retirement and reusable workflow refactor to land separately if the combined security review surface is too broad.

options.title: Pause Matrix Retirement
options.body: Keep the standalone runtime for now if release owners are not ready to own the new reusable QA Live Matrix path.

recommendation.title: Fix Indent, Then Approve Boundary
recommendation.body: Restore the Markdown continuation indent and have admin/security approve the dependency graph plus reusable workflow boundary for the resulting exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent history on QA Live and release workflow hardening, which is the unresolved human approval boundary.
